subject: Fail loudly on retired Skogsstyrelsen ImageServer proxies; offline CI tests
description: Owner decision 2026-10-12: small fix, no data download. kartor.skogsstyrelsen.se/kartor/*ArcGIS93Rest proxies now redirect to the map portal (or WAF 403), so slu_markfukt, skg_grunddata and skg_height parse HTML and CI fails on 4 live markfukt tests. Scope: shared ImageServer download helper used by the three fetchers that raises a clear retired-endpoint error (no redirects followed, no retries on permanent failures) pointing to the open geodataport bulk downloads; offline tests; live tests opt-in via IMINT_LIVE_TESTS=1. Intended files: imint/training/skg_imageserver.py (new), imint/training/slu_markfukt.py, imint/training/skg_grunddata.py, imint/training/skg_height.py, tests/test_slu_markfukt.py, tests/test_skg_imageserver.py. Not in scope: mirroring the open bulk data (backlog), any change to existing tiles.
